sentences.en: Wages vary in relation to the age of the worker.
sentences.zh: 工人的工资会根据其年龄有所不同。

sentences.en: The union bosses are fighting the freeze on wage hikes.
sentences.zh: 工会领导人在抵制冻结工资增长。

sentences.en: They agreed to raise wages and to stop hiring children.
sentences.zh: 他们同意提高工资并停止雇佣童工。

senses.zh: 进行，发动（运动、战争等）；开展
